messages.content: Customer Lantern Hill Brewing (CP-5120) says Cobalt 'never pays the garnishments'. Notes: Plus plan, 2 garnishments set up in June, withheld every run, no remittances recorded. What's the story?

Lantern Hill Brewing (CP-5120) is on Plus, and Plus doesn't include automatic garnishment remittance; only Premier does. Cobalt has withheld both garnishments on every run since June, but on Plus the employer has to send the money to the agencies. Next step: show them Reports > Deductions > Garnishment Remittance to send the payments now, and suggest they confirm with the agencies whether any payments are past due. If they'd rather Cobalt handle it, Premier is $119 + $12/employee.

Starter: 1 pay group. Plus: up to 5. Premier: unlimited. They're managed in Settings > Pay Groups. Moving an employee between groups takes effect on the next run if it's done before that run's cutoff (4:00 PM CT two business days before its pay date).
When does BenefitsBridge push deductions into payroll?

Every night at 2:00 AM CT. An enrollment approved today shows on tomorrow's payroll preview in Cobalt Run. Remind customers not to add benefit deductions by hand while waiting, or they'll be taken twice. Carrier feed updates are separate and take up to 10 business days.
our CT-300 clock in the back kitchen says OFFLINE since this morning. staff are still punching in, will those punches be lost??

Good news: punches are not lost. The CT-300 stores them locally and uploads them as soon as it reconnects; it syncs every 15 minutes once it is back on Wi-Fi or ethernet. Please check the network cable or Wi-Fi, then confirm the status in Cobalt Run > Settings > Devices. Timecards lock at the payroll cutoff (4:00 PM CT, two business days before the pay date), so if it is still offline an hour before that, call Cobalt Care at 555-0142 and we will help you enter the missing hours.
We switched banks. How do I change the account Cobalt pulls payroll from? Next payroll is in 3 days.

Thanks for the heads-up, we will make sure payroll is funded. Go to Settings > Company Bank and add the new account. We verify it with 2 micro-deposits under $1 that arrive in 2-3 business days, and you enter the amounts on that same screen. Because your next pay date is within 5 business days, Payroll Ops also needs a short verification call; please book it today at 555-0142 so the new account is approved before the 4:00 PM CT cutoff two business days before the pay date. Until then, keep enough funds in the old account.
What's the difference in price between Plus and Premier? We have 18 employees and want benefits.

Great question. With 18 employees, Plus is $69 + $9 x 18 = $231/month, and Premier is $119 + $12 x 18 = $335/month. Premier includes BenefitsBridge, unlimited pay groups, automatic garnishment remittance and a named Payroll Ops contact. On Plus, BenefitsBridge is a $4/employee add-on ($72/month for you), so Plus + benefits is $303/month. Annual billing takes 10% off either plan. You can switch in Settings > Plan & Billing, and the change starts with your next billing cycle.
Can an employee split her direct deposit between checking and savings?

Yes, she can. In Cobalt Run > People > [employee] > Pay Method, add the second account and set either a fixed amount or a percentage for savings; the rest goes to checking. She can also do this herself in the MyCobalt portal. Changes saved before the cutoff (4:00 PM CT two business days before the pay date) apply on that run. Please double check the account numbers, since a rejected deposit costs a $15 ACH return fee.
We're thinking about going from Premier down to Plus to save money. What do we lose?

Happy to lay it out. Moving from Premier to Plus means: BenefitsBridge becomes a $4/employee add-on, you are limited to 5 pay groups, Cobalt no longer sends garnishment payments to agencies for you (you would use Reports > Deductions > Garnishment Remittance), you lose the 2 free Express Off-Cycle runs per quarter, and you lose your named Payroll Ops contact. The change is made in Settings > Plan & Billing and takes effect on your next billing cycle, so payroll is not interrupted.
How long does a W-2c take to get filed? Employee needs it soon for a loan

We'll get it moving quickly. After you submit a correction in TaxDesk > Year-End > W-2 Corrections, Cobalt files the W-2c within 5 business days, and the employee's copy is posted to MyCobalt > Documents at the same time. The fee is $25 per W-2c. If the loan officer only needs a copy of the original W-2, she can download it from MyCobalt for free today.
